choose-level-75.title: Choose your level
choose-level-75.subtitle: Two 75-day app programs — same window, different rules.

products.title: A Challenge to Move
products.description: Your 22-day roadmap to move better and feel better — a practical guide to building a daily movement habit in just seven minutes.
products.note: Includes access to the interactive 7-minute / 22-day app

image.alt: A Challenge to Move book cover

products.title: A Challenge to Move app
products.description: Guided 7-minute workouts, a 22-day calendar, and built-in exercise and rest timers.

image.alt: A Challenge to Move app icon

products.title: 75 Focused
products.description: The strict, all-in track: 75 straight days of daily non-negotiables — training, clean eating, hydration, reading, and a progress check-in. Miss a day and you start over.

products.title: 75 Adaptive
products.tagline: Show up every day, your way.
products.description: The flexible track: 75 days of daily movement, better eating, and recovery built in — adjustable to your schedule and body, with no restart penalty.

products.title: 30-Day Whole Food Plan
products.description: Eat real, whole food with daily app guidance — simple meals, grocery focus, and habits that last beyond the month.
